n_family_breakdown: 19 screened configurations (docs/results/p2_positioning_flow_screen.json) + 2 lab configurations; stress reruns and two screen reruns of S12 / S15 (fidelity checks) have the same hashes

prior_hypotheses.build_up_squeeze: fade a >= 1 daily-ATR 24h move made with >= 10% OI build-up: -0.078R, t_day -3.13 (S2) -> rejected; read the other way it is OI-confirmed momentum
prior_hypotheses.deleveraging_reversal: fade a >= 1 daily-ATR 24h move made while OI fell >= 8%: +0.023R, t_day 0.62 (S1); stronger flush +0.010R (S7) -> rejected
prior_hypotheses.informed_vs_retail: follow the 4h divergence of the top-trader position ratio from the global account ratio: -0.018R, t_day -1.92 (S4; effectively 2023-2024, top-trader ratios ~13% of 2022) -> rejected

lab_runs.label: oimom48
lab_runs.note: alpha code 983b8dd71212731c: no retail filter (= retail_filter 0 of the final code); screen S12

lab_runs.label: oimom48_retail
lab_runs.note: final code 32cb67ec764b1129, shipped defaults; screen S15

final_candidates.rule: at each 4h close: |24h return| / (daily ATR14 / close) >= 1.0, ctx.extras oi_chg_24h >= +10% and ctx.extras ls_acc_chg_4h against the trade -> follow the move; skip if the upcoming funding x side > 0.03%/8h; market entry, stop 2.5 daily ATR, no target, time stop 48h - 1 min (engine 0.5R extension)

coverage: OI 99.7% and global account ratio 95% of 2022 buckets (the rule needs only these two), so every year trades; top-trader ratios (~13% of 2022) and the taker ratio (65%) are not used by the candidate

diagnostics.screen_fidelity: 623 of 624 lab trades matched by the screen (S15), mean R difference -0.0012

drift_adjusted.note: R minus the side's share of the symbol's average log drift of that year over the same holding time (scratch drift.py)

diagnostics.concentration: top 5 exit days 19.3R of 53.4R total; bottom 5 -9.6R

robustness_neighbours.note: screen avgR, t_day; every neighbour positive in all three years; read only, the defaults were fixed before

diagnostics.long_short: 571 longs / 53 shorts: the rule is symmetric but large moves with OI build-up are mostly rallies; 2022 (bear market, -69% equal-weight) longs +0.082R

selection_caveat: the direction (follow, not fade) was taken from the rejected build-up fade (S2); the 48h hold, funding filter, 2.5-ATR stop and retail filter were each chosen after one screen; the in-sample t_day is selected from 21 configurations. VALID (once, gatekeeper) is the real test.
